decks.notesZh: 来自 ECDICT 的 BNC／当代语料库前 3000 词频词项，加上主题与场景词；频率池排除明确标为人名、姓氏的词，主题白名单可保留。
decks.notesEn: Union of ECDICT BNC/contemporary frequency ranks 1–3000 and curated topic/scenario words; explicitly labelled personal names/surnames are excluded from the frequency pool unless curated.

decks.notesZh: 按教育考试院 2016 版词表四级部分提取，含所列派生词和拼写变体，仅收录有词典释义的词项；覆盖缺口见来源报告。
decks.notesEn: Matched dictionary entries from the CET-4 portion of the official 2016 syllabus, including listed derivatives and spelling variants; see coverage report for gaps.

decks.notesZh: 按教育考试院 2016 版词表提取，包含四级基础和标星六级词，以及所列派生词、拼写变体；覆盖缺口见来源报告。
decks.notesEn: Matched entries from the official 2016 syllabus, including basic CET-4 words, starred CET-6 additions, listed derivatives and spelling variants; see coverage report for gaps.

decks.notesZh: 来自 ECDICT 的 ky 考研标签参考词库，保留真实词典词项；未核对当年英语一／二完整大纲，不应作为唯一备考词表。
decks.notesEn: Real ECDICT entries tagged ky. A reference collection, not a verified complete current-year English I/II syllabus or a sole exam-preparation list.
